visualCharacteristics.purpose: Large light serif pull quote with an attribution (name, title) and an optional round avatar and chevron story link.
visualCharacteristics.description: Quotation in mayo-display 40px/44px weight 300, centered column (two thirds of the content width on desktop). Attribution below: optional 64/80px round avatar, grey bold name, grey 16px title and/or blue chevron link. On a light-blue section it sits on the band (section style, not the block).

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: quotation paragraph. Row 2 (optional): one cell with an optional avatar image, the name paragraph, then a title paragraph and/or a link paragraph.
contentPattern.description: The first text paragraph of row 2 is the name; a paragraph holding only a link is the chevron link; any other paragraph is the title. An image-only paragraph becomes the round avatar.
contentPattern.blockContent: Pull quote 'A diverse staff makes every single aspect...' attributed to Gianrico Farrugia, M.D., President & CEO, Mayo Clinic
table: Avatar image (optional), name paragraph, title paragraph and/or link

reuseGuidance: Use for a standalone quotation with a named speaker. Put the quotation in row 1, and the avatar/name/title/link in one cell in row 2. Use section style light-blue for the blue band version.
